input.solution: Existing solution in NanoClaw/Claude Agent SDK - Outbound Deduplication
input.why: Triple messages (each inbound → 3 identical outbound responses) undermine reliability and user experience. Deduplication ensures idempotent outbound message handling across retries, provider errors, and session failures — critical for unpredictable network conditions where the same message may be formatted and queued multiple times.
input.notes: NanoClaw already implements outbound deduplication in writeMessageOut() (/app/src/db/messages-out.ts:36-79). Identical messages (same destination channel_type, platform_id, in_reply_to, content) sent within a 60-second DEDUP_WINDOW are automatically collapsed to a single outbound row. The function returns the original seq number, so callers (send_message MCP tool, final <message> blocks) receive valid message IDs even for deduplicated sends. Tests confirm it works correctly (messages-out.test.ts). The mechanism provides idempotent outbound delivery: if the agent or container retries sending the same response, only one message reaches the user. This is the single source of truth pattern — the outbound database is read-only by the host during delivery polling.
